    }

            if (y % 2 == 1) res = mult(res, x);

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;

    static long plus(long a, long b) {
        return ((a + b) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
    }

    static long times(long a, long b) {
        return ((a * b) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
    }

    static long power(long a, long e) {
        if (e == 0) return 1;
        long half = power(a, e / 2);
        long sq = times(half, half);
        if ((e & 1) == 0) return sq;
        return times(sq, a);
    }

    static long inverse(long a) {
        return power(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        long[] prev = new long[k + 1];
        prev[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            long[] cur = new long[k + 1];
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                long v = prev[j];
                cur[j] = plus(cur[j], times(v, j));
                cur[j + 1] = plus(cur[j + 1], times(v, n - j));
            }
            prev = cur;
        }

        long x = inverse(m);
        long poly = 0;
        for (int i = k; i >= 1; i--) {
            poly = times(poly, x);
            poly = plus(poly, prev[i]);
        }
        long ans = times(poly, x);

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
